title: Admiral Ackbar
subtitle: It's A Trap!
text: Action [1 resource, Exhaust]: Exhaust a non-leader unit. If you do, its controller creates an X-Wing token.
deployBox: On Attack: You may exhaust a unit. If you do, its controller creates an X-Wing token.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
